raw_segments.text: I grieve to leave Thornfield. I love Thornfield. I love it because I have lived in it a full
and delightful life, momentarily at least. I have not been trampled on. I have not been
petrified. I have not been buried with inferior minds and excluded from every glimpse of communion
with what is bright and energetic and high. I have talked face to face with what I reverence
with what I delight in, with an original, a vigorous, an expanded mind.
